title: DiscoveryStory - Metadata API
description: Represents the metadata associated with a story used in Einstein Discovery.

application.description: The CRM Analytics app the story is associated with.

autopilot.description: Optional. The autopilot status for the story. One of the following strings: Enabled Disabled

classificationThreshold.description: Optional. The threshold for classification predictions for the story.

label.description: The story label. If you package a story, this label appears in Package Manager.

outcome.description: The selected outcome of the story.

sourceContainer.description: The source ID for the story.

sourceType.description: The source type of the story. One of the following strings: AnalyticsDataset LiveDataset Report

validationContainder.description: Optional. The validation ID for the story.

failureValue.description: Optional. The value if the story failed.

field.description: The field configuration for the story.

goal.description: The story outcome goal. One of the following strings: Maximize Minimize None

successValue.description: Optional. The value if the story succeeded.

type.description: The story outcome type. One of the following strings: Categorical Count Number Text
